name: Meross Matter Smart Plug with Energy Monitor MSS315 (US)

radios.note: Needs an existing 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network with IPv6. We found no official mention of Bluetooth.

matter.note: Meross sells it as a Matter plug. We could not find a CSA listing that names the MSS315 model number.

apple_home.note: Through Matter; Meross says a Matter-compatible hub is required for the chosen platform.

google_home.note: Through Matter; needs a Google Matter controller.

alexa.note: Through Matter; needs an Echo that works as a Matter controller. We did not confirm whether the Meross Alexa skill also covers this model.

smartthings.note: Through Matter; needs a SmartThings hub that supports Matter.

home_assistant.note: Meross doesn't list Home Assistant, and HA has no official Meross integration. Reviews show the EU version pairing via HA's Matter integration, but nothing official covers the US model.

hubRequired.note: Meross says energy monitoring in its app needs no hub. Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings need their own Matter controller.

localControl.note: Meross describes Matter control as local. Cloud-free behaviour of the Meross app itself is not documented.

energyMonitoring.note: Real-time and historical use in the Meross app. Whether readings reach Matter platforms on the US model is not confirmed by Meross.

maxLoadWatts.note: We found no official electrical rating for the US MSS315 in Meross's pages. Check the label on the plug.

summary: The Meross MSS315 is a US Wi-Fi plug with an energy meter that reaches Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings through Matter. Energy data shows in the Meross app, which needs no hub; each third-party platform needs its own Matter controller. It needs a 2.4 GHz network with IPv6. We could not find an official load rating for the US model.
caveats: Needs 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi with IPv6 enabled on the router.
Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings each need a Matter controller.
Meross recalled certain batches of the EU version in 2023; the notice does not cover this US model.
